centerline_geometry_samples.method: 101 snapshot hit_edge samples per terminal, not 101 delivered pointer events. Eligibility additionally excludes ports and objects.

native_terminal_selection.precedence: Native pointer route remains port, object, then edge. Ordinary straight/cubic/orthogonal edges and a topmost ordinary crosslink retain snapshot-order overlap behavior. Dense ancestry alone opts into nearest-terminal preference.
indistinguishable_areas: Exactly coincident terminal segments and equal-distance terminal ties cannot encode a unique intended branch; highest snapshot index wins.
Shared trunks away from any eligible terminal do not identify a unique branch; highest snapshot index wins.
Port/object overlap areas belong to those higher-priority interactions and are not usable edge targets.

visual_review.method: All four new terminal captures inspected directly. Original 20 rasters regenerated byte-identically to 58609ab, so the earlier observations below are retained as prior review rather than a fresh visual inspection of every old frame.

frames.steps: Open the six-topic synthetic map.
frames.expected: Two root sides, ordinary editable topic controls and an independent crosslink.
frames.observed: Six ordinary topic controls, both root sides, tree edges, crosslink and minimap are visible.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Image establishes this synthetic initial layout only.

frames.steps: Deliver F2 through AppKit NSEvent/native queue; insert text through the public event API.
frames.expected: The wrapped draft is legible inside its temporary editor layout. This is not physical IME evidence.
frames.observed: The full Draft/café/combining-accent, Korean, Hebrew and emoji draft is visible across two editor rows, with the footer and Share card clear of the editor.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Native inset and wide-glyph space are reserved in a temporary layout; semantic text is still uncommitted. This uses queued F2 plus public text events, not a physical IME. The wider editor leaves part of child #5 beyond the right viewport.

frames.steps: Space folds Research; Find receives an Arabic query.
frames.expected: A hidden topic remains discoverable without changing stored folds.
frames.observed: Arabic query and Field notes breadcrumb match appear above the folded map; replay reports five visible topics.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Overlay obscures part of the graph; fold/search semantics beyond the displayed path rely on the replay.

frames.steps: Use F6, Enter, type Move branch, Enter, type Research, Enter through public key/text events.
frames.expected: The branch appears in the target lane, clear of stationary neighbors and revealed in the viewport; committed tree unchanged.
frames.observed: Test an idea is revealed on the Research lane below Field notes, with a rerouted edge and no stationary sibling overlap. Draft still shows its committed child count.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: The preview separates moving cards from stationary neighbors; final vertical placement becomes authoritative at commit. Field notes remains partly outside the left viewport.

frames.steps: Escape cancels the semantic transaction.
frames.expected: Document encoding equals its pre-preview encoding; no history entry.
frames.observed: Cancelled status and the prior Draft-to-Test-an-idea relationship return.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay explicitly compares document encodings before/after cancellation; leftmost node remains partly cropped.

frames.steps: Commit the semantic move once.
frames.expected: Moved branch is at its destination; conflicting neighbors start past it along their paths, while safe neighbors retain prior bounds.
frames.observed: The committed #5 card is fixed at its final Research-side position. Field notes starts higher along its existing path, with its footer clear of #5; no card overlap is visible.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Native replay asserts no visible other topic overlaps the committed #5 bounds at start and midpoint. The focused trajectory contract covers initial and later path collisions against two moved descendants, plus ordinary-neighbor interpolation. Left-edge cropping persists. These are deterministic geometry checks, without presentation-timed smoothness evidence.

frames.steps: Advance the public frame clock by 90 ms.
frames.expected: Shared canvas geometry interpolates without obscuring the committed branch; semantic content and history are unchanged.
frames.observed: Field notes is farther along its upward path, clear of #5; #5 stays at its committed destination.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Native replay asserts non-overlap. The 90 ms interval is an injected public frame tick; semantic/history stability and ordinary-neighbor interpolation are checked by contracts, without wall-clock smoothness or latency claims.

frames.steps: Advance the remaining 90 ms after the single semantic commit.
frames.expected: Neighbor bounds reach the exact destination; one semantic commit changes parent and sibling order.
frames.observed: Final Research layout contains Field notes and Test an idea; Draft has zero children.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay checks animation has settled after the second 90 ms tick. Leftmost content is partly outside the viewport.

frames.steps: Invoke the actual Undo command.
frames.expected: Stable topic IDs, prior parent/order and links restored.
frames.observed: Undo status appears and Test an idea returns under Draft.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Visual hierarchy restoration is visible; stable IDs/history internals are not proved by pixels alone.

frames.steps: Repeat the same move with the explicit reduced-motion policy.
frames.expected: The same final layout appears immediately, without animation.
frames.observed: Reduced-motion capture shows the same final Research branch layout immediately.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay explicitly checks reflow is inactive; this uses an explicit policy rather than changing the OS preference.

frames.steps: Public pointer-down on a displayed topic header, then pointer-move onto Share findings.
frames.expected: The proposed branch and parent remain separately legible; shared capture and destination hit testing use committed geometry.
frames.observed: Share findings and Test an idea appear as separate controls with a connecting edge; the moving branch no longer covers the destination title or body.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Pointer hit regions remain the committed layout. The target header truncates its trailing emoji; its body label and the branch are legible. Field notes is cropped at the left viewport.

frames.steps: Deliver pointer-cancel to the active session, then repeat the drag for the next slide.
frames.expected: Original document encoding is retained without a history commit.
frames.observed: Cancelled status and the original hierarchy return after pointer-cancel.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay explicitly compares encoded content after public pointer-cancel; this is not physical AppKit capture-loss evidence.

frames.steps: Deliver pointer-up to the same session.
frames.expected: The target becomes the parent in one history step.
frames.observed: Test an idea is attached to Share findings; Draft has zero children and Share findings has one.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay asserts parent ID 6 and advances a deterministic completion tick; leftmost content is cropped.

frames.steps: Invoke Undo.
frames.expected: The prior hierarchy returns.
frames.observed: Undo restores Test an idea under Draft and Share findings to zero children.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: This is the actual command replay, not a physical undo shortcut exercise.

frames.steps: Change Draft side, increase spacing, then Fit.
frames.expected: Deterministic layout reflows with stable identities.
frames.observed: Draft/Test an idea move to the left root side; after Fit all six controls are inside the viewport with changed spacing.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Only this fixed fixture and camera are reviewed.

frames.steps: Select two topics, add a connector, then open Outline.
frames.expected: Outline and graph share one document; links do not change ancestry.
frames.observed: Outline lists six topic breadcrumbs; underlying badges show the additional Research/Share findings link.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: The overlay hides graph geometry. Crosslink ancestry invariance is not independently established by this image.

frames.steps: Atomically save, edit, write recovery, and load the recovery envelope.
frames.expected: Recovered content appears; original saved file is retained.
frames.observed: Recovered-draft text appears on Draft and status says recovered in memory; the ordinary saved fixture lacks that suffix while its recovery envelope contains it.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Saved and recovery bytes were inspected separately; no power-loss or restart-resilience claim.

frames.steps: Parse the synthetic loss.mm fixture and display the paged report.
frames.expected: Unsupported data is visible; XML source remains untouched and inert.
frames.observed: Report visibly lists four imported topics, zero connectors, dangling/self connector omission, inert omitted elements and unsafe/local hyperlink omission.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Only the displayed report page and synthetic loss.mm fixture were exercised; source hashes stayed unchanged.

frames.steps: Open the large fixture with its root folded.
frames.expected: One visible topic; this does not establish expanded native capacity.
frames.observed: One large folded root displays 999 children, with explicit expanded-capacity-not-accepted text. The dense root now has an output port on each side for stable edge identities while folding.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: Replay reports one visible topic. This is not 1,000 expanded native controls.

frames.steps: Open the expanded 1,000-topic fixture with the public canvas camera.
frames.expected: A shared vertical trunk joins the visible sibling stubs at readable scale. The expanded fixture keeps all topic controls and edges in the model.
frames.observed: A single narrow cyan vertical trunk runs between the root and the child column. Separate horizontal stubs terminate at the five visible children. The minimap overlaps part of the lowest card.
frames.limits_or_assertion_evidence: The layout contract checks individual child-stub hits and crosslink routing. This viewport culls ordinary controls.

logs.method: Filtered result excerpts omit compiler warnings/stack traces; full local logs retained in task scratch directory. Review timing files are original four-line metric excerpts.

unverified: Physical pointer/keyboard, NSApplication dispatch, IME, chooser, VoiceOver and independent usability. VoiceOver was not exercised.
Fresh performance timing of the terminal-selection commit; all-interaction 8 ms acceptance; fully visible 1000-topic and expanded 10000-topic native capacity; D03 combined capacity integration.
Browser navigation of the regenerated 24-frame slideshow, fresh AppKit layer/capacity test, clean packaged consumer, full repository suite and remote CI.
Compositor/scanout latency, GPU work, allocations, memory, sustained thermals, live Freeplane parity and other hosts/viewports.

confidence.level: High for the reproduced/fixed synthetic terminal cases, preserved tested precedence and captured provenance. Moderate for portability of historical absolute timings; insufficient for full performance or independent usability acceptance.
confidence.would_change_conclusion: A failure of the same native/public pointer cases, an ordinary consumer precedence regression, a D03 index contract failure, different replay pixels or controlled timing repeats would change the corresponding conclusion.
